changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter function [graph].[ReformatSegments] ( @original xml ) returns xml as begin declare @reformatted xml if @original is not null begin set @reformatted = @original.query(' <path> { let $segments := (/path/segment) for $x in $segments return <segment> <level>{if (count($x/@level) gt 0) then data($x/@level) else 1 }</level> <position>{if (count($x/@position) gt 0) then data($x/@position) else 1 }</position> <assetTypeId>{data($x/@assetTypeId)}</assetTypeId> <assetId>{data($x/@assetId)}</assetId> <parentLevel>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@level)}</parentLevel> <parentPosition>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@position)}</parentPosition> <parentAssetId>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@assetId)}</parentAssetId> <value>{data($x)}</value> <leaf>{$x is $segments[last()]}</leaf> </segment> } </path>') end else begin set @reformatted = '<path />' end
return @reformatted end
